intent: The heading region at the top of a DialogContent, stacking the dialog's title over its description and staying pinned while the popup scrolls.
typical_uses: A DialogTitle over a one-line DialogDescription

dont_use_when.situation: The heading region of a card on the page

invariants.text: DialogHeader is a flex column whose children are spaced var(--space-2) apart.
DialogHeader is sticky at the top of its scroll container with the popup's own opaque background, so as a direct child of DialogContent it stays in view and masks the content scrolling under it.

anti_patterns.dont: Give DialogHeader a transparent background through `className`
anti_patterns.do_instead: Keep the header's background opaque; content scrolling in the popup paints through a transparent header while it stays pinned

bad.title: A header used outside a dialog popup
bad.why: DialogTitle needs an enclosing Dialog root and throws without one, and the header's sticky, opaque styling is built for the popup; use CardHeader and CardTitle in a card.
